title: Red Hat Security Advisory: osbuild-composer security update
description: Red Hat has issued a security update for osbuild-composer, a service used to build customized OS artifacts including VM images and OSTree commits. The update addresses multiple denial of service vulnerabilities in various Golang components used by osbuild-composer, such as gRPC, net/http, crypto/tls, and multipart form parsing. These vulnerabilities could allow denial of service attacks via malformed RPC requests, crafted HTTP Range headers, multiple ECH outer extension references, memory limit bypass in multipart parsing, and excessive HTTP/2 SETTINGS frames. The update is rated as important by Red Hat and applies to Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8.6 variants.
